text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san, Ardan-san! Would you like to 
enter a tournament with me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A tournament... you say? Hmm, what manner 
of competition might it be?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a tournament for a sumo card game 
called 'Dosukoi Card Chronicles'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's scheduled to be held in conjunction with the shopping district's festival—

text_block_list.name: Card shop manager
text_block_list.text:
'Dosukoi' doesn't have many players, you see... 
So I want to make this tournament as exciting as possible 
and get everyone interested in it!

text_block_list.name: Card shop manager
text_block_list.text:
You should definitely join in too, Chiyo-chan. 
Bring your friends along if you like, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, the manager is an acquaintance of my dad's, 
and he asked me to help out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see, a card game... 
I'm not very familiar with them, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Naturally, there is also a chance I will 
spar with Chiyono O, correct?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Win or lose, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I would be delighted to join. 
While I do not have much experience with card games, 
I shall do my utmost to liven things up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! 
I'll support you as much as I can, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
For the 'Dosukoi' tournament, the shopkeeper 
lent me cards! 
Now let's begin practicing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Draw a card— 
With a hand like this, victory is well within reach.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Consuming stamina to activate skill cards in succession! 
Moving from a 'Double Inside Grip' right into an 'All-Out Drive'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Before Ardan-san could recover her footing, 
she launched an all-out assault! As expected of Yaeno-san!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Things look dire, but―― 
Consuming willpower, she enters a 'Last Stand'! 
She holds her ground right at the edge of the ring...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(She held on! 
Ardan's tenacity is incredible too...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll spend all my remaining stamina... 
Follow-up attack: 'Frontal Crush-Out'!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... That's match, then... 
I couldn't counter. How regrettable.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it was an incredible match! 
Yaeno's attacks were so sharp, 
and Ardan's grit on the brink—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I think each of them showed their own strengths. 
I'm so glad I invited the two of you after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If there are people with all kinds of styles, 
the spectators will enjoy it more, too. 
It'll definitely hype up the competition!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Which is precisely why you called upon us... 
In that case, let us dedicate ourselves all the more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You're right. 
We'll hone our strengths even further through more training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—And that ends your turn. 
Now it's my turn, draw a card...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sweet, a Secret Technique Card! 
With this, we turn the tables and take the match!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Playing both sides in a match 
is definitely good practice after all. 
I feel like I could hone my gameplay even more...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san and Ardan-san 
are both helping out. 
I've got to do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please spar with me again today. 
After all, no practice surpasses real combat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The tournament is coming up soon, after all. 
Shall we head over to the cafeteria, then?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, perhaps somewhere a bit quieter 
would be better. I want to focus on the match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How about the dorm lobby, then? 
There should be few people around at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have no objections either. 
Well then, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Use 'Secrets of Thrusting and Pushing,' 
followed by a 'Fierce Throat Thrust.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Up until now, it's been Yaeno-san's pace. 
A strategy of fierce offense that doesn't give her opponent a chance to recover...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then... I use 'Immovable Center' to defend. 
Next, I'll replenish my hand with 'Focus'—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Ardan-san is holding her own, but... 
she's already backed right to the brink!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Victory is in sight... I'll settle it right here! 
Secret Technique: 'All-Out Brute Force'!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I've been waiting for that. Comeback secret technique! 
'Miracle Revival: Tottari'!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Shoot!! There are no matching cards left—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ghh... I admit defeat! 
To think you could pull off a comeback from that position...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was an incredible match! 
Both of you have gotten so much stronger 
since the last time you faced off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... 
Fufu... It was well worth asking 
Nakayama-san for her advice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I draw a cardâ Heh, looks like the heavens are on my side.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
âTurnabout secret technique: 'Split-Second Uchari.' 
That seals the match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To draw the turnaround card right here— 
No, that's not it... 
Were they aiming for this exact board state from the very start?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. 
Even if you sacrifice your other cards, 
you turn the board around in your favor.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the risk is massive. 
You could get blitzed early and suffer a one-sided defeat. 
Do you still want to go with this strategy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. A fearless resolve... 
That is the strength 
Chiyono O recognized in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to hone my strengths 
even further. 
This victory is all thanks to your guidance...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Goodness, to think that happened. Actually, I too—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see right through your technique!
Secret Art: 'Fierce God Overarm Throw'!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ghh, well played...! 
You're not just attacking. 
Could you be reading several moves ahead of me...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is not merely about playing your cards. 
The cards you hold, the cards you draw next... 
Consider how to assemble them and strike.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Read the enemy's moves, and draw forth from within 
a strike to shatter them. 
Accomplish that, and a hundred victories in a hundred battles shall be no mere dream.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much... 
I swear I will grasp my formula for victory!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I still have a long way to go after all... 
With more training, I shall truly master 
what No Reason-san has taught me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san, Yaeno-san... 
To think you even held special training for me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Why go so far? 
You two are only going along 
with my request as it is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You believed in my unique strength—no one else's— 
and placed your hopes in me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to answer those feelings. 
With everything I have—with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do not want to lose. 
Not to Yaeno-san, and not to Chiyono O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. 
I will give it my all and live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (...Both of them are trying so hard to live up to my expectations...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (...Me too—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be someone who can live up to 
both their expectations—!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. 
I won't... lose either, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you want to beat your friend at the tournament. 
If that's the case, we'd be glad to help out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very good at difficult games, but... 
if we work together, we can pull through! 
I'd welcome special training with open arms!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
I'm so glad I talked to everyone about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Our bond is not forged in races alone. 
This shall be a fine opportunity to display our will to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll live up to everyone's expectations, 
and prove how strong I can get! 
So train me as hard as you can!

Today, I came to watch a gaming tournament
held at the shopping district festival.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived. 
I'll pour everything I gained from our special training into this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's give it everything we've got. 
So neither of us has any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the results of our special training too. 
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is the turning point...! Secret Technique! 
'Flowing Uwatedashinage'!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Your sharpness on the brink has been polished even further— 
As expected of you, Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Stillâthe victor will be me! Secret technique! 
'Ultimate Flash: Underarm Throw'!!

text_block_list.name: Card shop manager
text_block_list.text:
And that settles ittt!! 
Coming out on top in a fierce throwing duel against Mejiro Ardan 
is Sakura Chiyono O!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's a seriously high-level battle... 
I've never seen people get this hyped up over "Dosukoi" 
in my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen this before, but it looks like fun! 
Maybe I should give it a try too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Splendidly done, Chiyono O-san. 
I came up short, and I couldn't be more frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible too, Ardan-san. 
No one knew how it would end until the very last second...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The only undefeated ones left are myself and Chiyono O-san. 
Next is the finals. Truly, my blood is boiling...!

text_block_list.name: Card shop manager
text_block_list.text:
No holding back now! The final bout of today's tournament! 
The championship match begins now!

text_block_list.name: Two people
text_block_list.text: And now—hakkeyoi!!

Acknowledging each other and competing with all their might. 
That was the radiant bond they showed the world...
